title.narrative: Empowering women, girls, and vulnerable men and boys to access their rights and quality services through an area-based response.

description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed intervention aims to strengthen the governance structure, improve ownership and increase sustainability by providing CCCM assistance to 50,000 vulnerable displaced individuals in MMC. The intervention will respond to CCCM crucial needs for displaced and newly displaced families. Under the Housing, Land, and Property (HLP) component, this intervention aims to enhance the security of tenure for communities affected by displacement, with a particular focus on women and girls. This comprehensive effort involves providing valuable information, one-on-one counselling, and legal assistance in land tenure documentation. Simultaneously, the initiative seeks to strengthen community-based dispute resolution and knowledge on HLP. NRC will provide training, as well as technical and material support to strengthen local capacities of key institutions in charge of management and administration of land, and Collaborative Dispute Resolution (CDR) actors. In line with allocation strategy, the intervention will enable more women and girls to access HLP documentation, secure equitable representation in dispute resolution structures, and empower women and girls through capacity building and legal/administrative support to claim and enjoy their HLP rights in accordance with statutory system. lt/pgtltpgtAn innovative digital land title will also be piloted under this intervention in collaboration with Borno Geographic Information System (BOGIS) to facilitate ease of access, prevent physical damage or deterioration of documents overtime, and guarantee long term preservation of property records in a central database. As part of the area based response, the HLP component will complement the CCCM and education interventions, through facilitating protective land tenure and/ or lease agreements, effectively safeguarding against potential exploitation of facilities. Drawing on NRC's distinctive expertise in HLP programming, the intervention goes beyond direct implementation, and will extends support to partner agencies in the target location, providing crucial assistance such as due diligence and tenure documentation. This collaborative approach ensures a more robust and holistic impact on HLP issues in the targeted communities. Additionally, NRC will carry out protection monitoring, using the harmonized tool by the Protection Sector North East Nigeria (PSNE) which follows an area-based approach that focuses on understanding the protection environment at the level of camp, informal site, or within the host community and includes all status groups among the population. Site management activities will be undertaken to facilitate equitable access to assistance, protection and services for displaced people in out of camps in settings and to strengthen community participation. lt/pgtltpgtThe proposed intervention will also offer an alternative pathway for learning for out of school adolescent girls, equipping them with relevant soft vocational skills to engage in gainful employment and income generating activities. Child protection will be integrated to ensure protection barriers are addressed for adolescent girls in accessing education and engaging in livelihood opportunities.ltspangt Overall, 300 out of school adolescent girls will benefit from soft vocational skill acquisition and will be provided with start up kits to engage in livelihoods and income generation. Additionally, 800 out of school adolescent girls will access non formal education and mainstream into the formal education system. Further 1000 parents and caregivers will be trained on positive parenting skills and 5000 children and adolescents will benefit from services at the child - adolescent friendly service center where referrals will be done for further support where needed. To ensure a holistic program, 40 lt/spangtltspangtteachers/ facilitators (2 and 20F 20M ) and 20 community leaders (10F 10M) will be trained on various topics such as pedagogy, PSSA, PSEA and child protection.lt/spangtlt/pgt
